package.name: karis_perception
package.description: KARIS perception: detector (YOLO / RF-DETR) + 6D pose tracking of the kitting parts as a ROS 2 node (FoundationPose runs in the Isaac ROS helper, karis_isaac_fp), the part classes and CAD meshes, a camera player for recordings, and tools (TensorRT export, detector benchmark, Isaac meshes). Runs in the perception container (ROS 2 Humble). Trained models are read from KARIS_DIR/models (not in git). Not available as rosdep keys (installed by docker/perception/Dockerfile): ultralytics, torch, rfdetr, pyrealsense2.
